name: Google Play
author: Enplace
summary: Follow an Android app on Google Play: what's live, its staged rollout, reviews and crash rates, from the Play Console.
description: Goes on an app product that ships to Android. Connect the Play Console once with a service account key (the steps open the right Google pages and tick themselves off), and it shows what's live on production, raises, halts or finishes a staged rollout, lists the week's reviews with a reply box, and warns when crash or ANR rates pass Google Play's line. The key is shared with Play testing, which gets builds to testers. With Release cycle on, the cycle numbers releases from what's live. For iPhone and Mac, add App Store to the same product.
